title: 教玩具行业与产品全景

intro.visual: 温尚厂区 + 整园设计鸟瞰图
intro.background: 浙江温尚教玩具有限公司（ZHEJIANG WENSHANG EDUCATIONAL TOYS CO., LTD.），品牌瓯尚居，2010年成立于温州，厂区20000平方米，是集自主研发、设计生产加工、市场营销、售后服务于一体的大型生产企业。产品线覆盖：室内活动教室（托育宝宝/森林原木/通用家具）、体能运动（体能拓展/感统软包/攀爬墙）、功能教室（生活室/阅读室/美工室/科学室/木工坊/建构室等11类）、通用家具（阅读阁楼/沙发系列/智慧教室）、综合产品（墙面玩具/托班玩具/桌面玩具/体育玩具）、户外大型玩具（绿野寻踪/童话森林/树屋攀爬等主题系列）、户外14项功能区。
intro.desc: 了解温尚公司全貌和完整产品线，建立行业认知框架。
tasks: 了解温尚公司背景和规模
理解整园定制服务模式
outcomes: 能用英语介绍温尚公司
能向客户介绍整园服务

oneLiner.en: WENSHANG is a 20,000 sqm kindergarten furniture and playground manufacturer in Wenzhou, offering turnkey solutions from indoor classrooms to 14 outdoor functional zones — over 100 product categories.
oneLiner.cn: 温尚是温州20000平米的幼儿园家具和游乐设备生产商，提供从室内教室到14个户外功能区的整园解决方案——100多个产品品类。

vocab.ex: We provide turnkey solutions from design to installation.
vocab.exCn: 我们提供从设计到安装的一站式解决方案。

vocab.ex: Our kindergarten furniture includes tables, chairs, beds and storage cabinets.
vocab.exCn: 我们的幼儿园家具包括桌椅、床和收纳柜。

vocab.ex: Outdoor playground equipment is our high-margin product line.
vocab.exCn: 户外游乐设备是我们的高毛利产品线。

vocab.ex: We design 11 types of functional classrooms including art, science and wood workshop.
vocab.exCn: 我们设计11种功能教室，包括美工、科学和木工坊。

vocab.ex: Our sensory integration soft play series is popular for nursery classes.
vocab.exCn: 我们的感统软包系列在托班很受欢迎。

vocab.ex: Wall-mounted toys save floor space and keep classrooms tidy.
vocab.exCn: 墙面玩具节省地面空间，保持教室整洁。

vocab.ex: We offer free site survey for projects over a certain size.
vocab.exCn: 达到一定规模的项目我们提供免费现场测量。

vocab.ex: We provide installation guidance via video or on-site service.
vocab.exCn: 我们提供视频或上门安装指导。

mistakes.wrong: We are a trading company that sells kindergarten products.
mistakes.right: We are a manufacturer with a 20,000 sqm factory in Wenzhou, producing over 100 categories of kindergarten furniture and playground equipment, with our own R&D and design team.
mistakes.cn: 错误：说自己是贸易公司。客户更愿意和工厂合作，要强调20000平米厂区、自主研发、100+品类。

mistakes.wrong: We can make whatever you need.
mistakes.right: We specialize in kindergarten furniture and playground equipment — indoor classrooms, functional rooms, outdoor play structures and 14 functional zones. We do not do primary school desks or office furniture.
mistakes.cn: 错误：什么都说能做。专业的供应商知道自己的边界——只做幼儿园领域，不做中小学课桌或办公家具。

advanced.en: ZHEJIANG WENSHANG EDUCATIONAL TOYS CO., LTD., established in 2010, operates a 20,000 sqm factory in Wenzhou. We specialize in kindergarten furniture and playground equipment, with six product lines: activity classrooms, physical exercise equipment, functional classrooms, general furniture, educational toys and outdoor play structures — serving nearly 1,000 kindergartens nationwide and exporting to multiple countries.

advanced.en: Our turnkey service covers six stages: client consultation, concept discussion, on-site measurement, custom design, production and shipping, and installation acceptance — with a dedicated project manager assigned from day one.
advanced.cn: 我们的整园服务覆盖六个阶段：客户接洽、方案沟通、现场测量、设计定制、生产运输、安装验收——从第一天起就指派专属项目经理。

culture.title: 为什么客户更愿意和工厂合作
culture.content: 外贸客户（尤其是大客户）更愿意和工厂直接合作，原因有三：一是价格更低（没有贸易商中间差价）；二是可以验厂（factory audit），看生产能力和品控；三是定制更灵活（工厂可以改设计、改材质）。所以自我介绍时一定要强调：direct manufacturer、20000 sqm factory、own R&D team、welcome factory visit。温尚的品牌是瓯尚居（OUSHANGJU），英文WENSHANG，要统一使用。
